hints.title: Equivalence Classes
hints.text: Notice that firing at any target x destroys targets of form x + c * space, which share the exact same remainder modulo space.

hints.title: Modulo Aggregation
hints.text: Group all numbers by x modulo space. Track the count of numbers in each remainder class.

hints.title: Tie Breaking Criteria
hints.text: Find the remainder group with the highest count. In case of ties, select the smallest original integer in that group.

hints.title: Remainder Frequency Tracking Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass to compute modular residues and track minimal seeds.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing each number as a root target takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory to index counts and minimum seeds per residue.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulates the arithmetic progression reachability as modular residue equivalence.
